page.overview:
Who is Syldra?

Syldra is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy, and is a Grymoirian incarnation of Syldra originating from Final Fantasy V. Syldra is one of the six character representatives of that game, the other five being Bartz, Boko, Faris, Gilgamesh, and Enkidu.

Syldra appears with Faris and fights in conjunction with her.

These stats are for the storyline encountered version of Syldra. For the imprismable version, see Syldra★
